title: Hays Botany ID
range_authority_priority: Lady Bird Johnson Wildflower Center / NPSOT
notes: Three target-zone counties are required only to label a taxon confirmed project-native. Source-pool taxa may still be installed as range-unresolved, nonlocal, introduced, non-native/comparison, or other accurately labeled learner entries.
